childNodes.textContent: Swap the model and inspect exactly what was sent to it
When AI output is off, it is hard to tell whether the model or the prompt is at fault, and trying another model usually means a code change.
A setting switches the model for every AI step, and a prompt viewer shows the system and user prompt behind each result, so runs can be compared.
